name: Washing
overview: Scripture presents washing as both a physical and symbolic act, signifying purity and innocence before God. Washing of hands, as seen in Leviticus 15:11 and Deuteronomy 21:6, serves as a token of innocence, while Psalms 26:6 and 73:13 emphasize washing hands in innocency as a sincere approach to worship. Figuratively, washing also represents spiritual cleansing and regeneration, as expressed in Psalms 51:7 and Proverbs 30:12, where the cleansing of the heart and the need to be washed from filthiness highlight the necessity of inner purity that only God can provide.
